description: List the upcoming public deadlines (open and announced) in date order, with their type. open_call is true only for open submission and application calls; registration and decision dates are listed with their type and are never open calls. Set open_calls_only to list open calls only. Filter by research field, category key, and date range. Returns at most 20 deadlines per call; use next_offset for the next page.

category.description: Category key, for example 'economics:macroeconomics', 'finance:asset-pricing' or 'political_science:political-theory'. Use list_calendars to see keys.
category.title: Category

field.description: Research field key, for example economics, business or political_science. list_calendars gives the current fields.
field.title: Field

open_calls_only.description: List open submission and application calls only.
open_calls_only.title: Open Calls Only

name: list_upcoming_deadlines

deadline_type.description: full_paper, extended_abstract, abstract, panel_proposal, call_for_works, application, registration, notification (a decision date), or empty when not yet typed.
deadline_type.title: Deadline Type

open_call.description: True when the deadline is open and asks for a submission or an application. Registration, decision and untyped deadlines are never open calls.
open_call.title: Open Call

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last page.
next_offset.title: Next Offset

title: List upcoming deadlines
